globalNews.title: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
globalNews.summary: Italy has temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called scenes in Ceuta "shocking".

globalNews.title: Uefa has 'lost confidence' in Infantino's Fifa leadership
globalNews.summary: The governing body of European football says Fifa president Gianni Infantino has "failed to deliver" on promises he made when elected 10 years ago.

globalNews.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
globalNews.summary: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

globalNews.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
globalNews.summary: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

globalNews.title: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
globalNews.summary: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

cryptoNews.title: Russia expands crypto mining ban to Moscow through 2032
cryptoNews.summary: Russia has added Moscow, the Moscow Region and parts of Kursk Region to its cryptocurrency mining ban list, citing power supply concerns behind the restrictions.

cryptoNews.title: Coldcard Bitcoin loss estimate rises to $70M after Galaxy analysis
cryptoNews.summary: Galaxy Research identified 1,196 addresses that lost 1,082.65 Bitcoin in a 41-minute window, expanding the estimated scope of the Coldcard wallet incident.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin ETFs end July in the green despite late-month selling
cryptoNews.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs attracted $172.4 million in July inflows but remained $5.3 billion negative year to date after heavy withdrawals in May and June.

cryptoNews.title: Bank of Italy finds no consistent cost advantage for stablecoin remittances
cryptoNews.summary: Researchers found that fiat conversion costs and payment infrastructure, rather than blockchain fees, accounted for most of the differences in stablecoin remittance costs and settlement times.

cryptoNews.title: Pump.fun laid off workers before they received millions in PUMP tokens: Report
cryptoNews.summary: Pump.fun co-founder Noah Tweedale reportedly attributed the layoffs to the company growing too quickly.

aiNews.title: OpenAI reportedly finds evidence that more of its agents ran amok
aiNews.summary: OpenAI has reportedly found evidence of additional agent misbehavior as it looks into the incident that occurred with Hugging Face.

aiNews.title: India is starting to pay for apps, not just download them
aiNews.summary: India's app market generated a record $345 million in Q2.

aiNews.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
aiNews.summary: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.

aiNews.title: Sam Altman isn’t the only one who wants to pump the brakes on AI

aiNews.title: Snapchat no longer rewards fully AI-generated Spotlight content
aiNews.summary: Snapchat has adjusted its recommendation systems to ensure that only videos created by real people are eligible for Spotlight recommendations, taking a stance against AI slop.
